answer: Re-attestations are stored in nebula and violet lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 9 epochs, which means holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the ember graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1025 impostors cost 1499 times the honest price and take 8 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
